kind: Observational tooling; no engine semantic adoption
contracts: GetProcessTimes: cumulative user/kernel CPU time in100ns units; not elapsed time
GetProcessMemoryInfo/PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX: working set/private commit/page faults; not allocation rate
GetProcessIoCounters: cumulative operation/transfer counts; not I/O latency
GetProcessAffinityMask: observable process affinity; not guaranteed VM entitlement
EnumProcessModulesEx: loaded module snapshot may race or fail; record gaps and hash only observed host/runtime files
QueryInformationJobObject(NULL): observer immediate job only, not automatically the child nested job
scope: Unmodified production gate invoked once with immutable corpus/profile/limits.
One-second external sampling; no case timing or GC-cause claim.
Allowlisted host metadata only, no environment/credential dump.
Lifetime-only observer job, no extra CPU/memory caps; production child keeps1200sec/8GiB.
Separate diagnostic workflow/check, never substitutes for required standalone gate; no retry loop.
Mock/caught Python controls for negative paths; no unhandled negative .NET launches.
